snippet.title: Were Egypt robbed of a place in the World Cup quarter-final?
snippet.description:
‘It’s either a foul or it isn’t’

Egypt were beaten in dramatic circumstances by Argentina 3-2 in the Round of 16 of the World Cup, but the Egyptian players and staff felt a major sense of injustice as they were dealt two refereeing blows.

The first was a goal chalked off due to a foul in the buildup that could have put them 3-0 up over the current World Cup holders, and the second was a perceived foul on Mohamed Salah in the buildup to Argentina’s winner, this time the goal wasn’t disallowed.

Do they have a case?

snippet.description:
Selain makan bersama, Mourinho membuat aturan baru yang tak pernah terjadi sebelumnya di Madrid. Gak ada jam karet, karna hukumannya akan kejam. Mourinho melihat kekacauan musim lalu, dan harus segera mengatasinya. Setiap sesi latihan para pemain kini wajib makan bersama satu meja untuk melatih kekompakan tim. Jika terlambat, tak hanya selesai dengan denda, mereka juga tak bisa lagi ikut latihan bersama tim, tapi Mourinho akan menyuruhnya latihan sendiri di gym.
